skill.name: Fixed-Size Container for Content Replacement
skill.description: Micro-technique using a fixed-dimension container to swap old content with new content while disabling controls during transition to prevent accidental interaction and maintain layout stability.
skill.skill_body:
When replacing content dynamically, use a fixed-size container or carousel to hold both old and new content. Ensure the container dimensions are predetermined and do not change during the swap. Disable all interactive elements (links, buttons, controls) within the container until the transition animation completes. Remove the old content after the transition finishes. This approach prevents unexpected layout shifts by keeping the container footprint constant.

## Objective

Maintain layout stability when replacing content by constraining container dimensions and preventing user interaction during transition
## Applicable Signals

- User action triggers content load
- New content is ready to display
- Old content needs to be replaced

## Contraindications

- Content size varies unpredictably or cannot be constrained
- Responsive flexible layouts are required
- Container dimensions cannot be fixed without breaking design
- Layout must adapt to variable content heights or widths

## Intervention Moves

- Set fixed dimensions on container element before content swap
- Disable all interactive elements within the container
- Initiate transition animation
- Wait for transition to complete
- Remove old content from DOM
- Re-enable interactive elements

## Workflow Steps

- Set fixed dimensions on the container element before content swap
- Disable all interactive elements (links, buttons, form controls) within the container
- Initiate transition animation to swap old content with new content
- Wait for transition animation to complete (typically 300–500 milliseconds)
- Remove old content from DOM
- Re-enable interactive elements
- Verify no layout shift occurred

## Constraints

- Container dimensions must be set before content swap begins
- All interactive controls must remain disabled during transition
- Transition duration should be brief to minimize user wait time
- Old content must be removed only after transition completes

## Cautions

- If controls are not disabled, users may accidentally click or tap during transition
- If container size is not fixed, layout shift will occur and CLS will increase
- Ensure transition timing is consistent across browsers and devices

## Output Contract

- Old content successfully replaced with new content within the same container bounds; no layout shift occurs; Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) metric remains unaffected; all controls remain disabled until transition completes; container footprint is unchanged before, during, and after swap.
